title: Groceries Tab
subtitle: A new Groceries tab: spending by store, every Costco item by month, your top items and their prices, and every Costco trip. Costco charges are split by their receipts.
intro: After the pull request merges, the code is already in your Sheet. One upgrade adds three tabs; then tell me in the chat and I load your Costco history and today's receipt.
**What does not change:** no balances, transactions or categories you have set. Costco charges already in Transactions stay as they are; new ones are split by their receipts.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before groceries 2026-11-15`.
Open the **App Setup** tab and check that **Build Script Version** reads `1.22.0`. If it shows an older number, wait a minute and reload the Sheet.
Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm. It takes a minute or two.
steps.done: The report lists Added tab: Grocery Items, Grocery Item Names and Groceries.

steps.text: Come back to the chat with Claude and say **upgrade done**. Claude then loads your Costco history (January 2024 to October 2026) and today's receipt.
steps.note: Until then the Groceries tab is empty.

steps.text: Open **Groceries**. Type a date in **Month** (B3), for example `10/1/2026`, to see every Costco item bought in October with what it cost.
steps.done: "What you bought at Costco" lists items such as Blueberries with Times Bought, Spent and Average Price.

steps.text: Scroll down for **What you buy most** (12 months, with the earlier and latest price) and **Costco trips**.
steps.note: Store totals at the top start in November 2026, when the bank feed started. Older Costco trips show in the item lists and the trip list.

steps.text: To rename an item or change what it counts as, open **Grocery Item Names** and edit the Item, Category or Subcategory on its row.
steps.note: Every receipt line with that item number follows. Snacks and drinks from Costco count as groceries; beer counts as Alcohol; paper towels, soap and bags as Household Supplies; diapers and wipes as kids' Supplies; dog chews as Pets.

steps.text: Send Claude a photo of a receipt, or a new export from costco.com (Orders & Purchases → In-Warehouse; trips usually show up within a day). Either works.
steps.note: A trip sent both ways counts once: the export copy is kept and the photo copy is set aside. When the card charge for a trip comes in, the next sync splits it by the receipt.
